Configure liter-llm to extract text with a vision-capable model

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = await XbergConverter.ExtractAsync(new ExtractInput { Kind = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ExtractInputKind>("\"uri\"", ConfigOptions)!, MimeType = "image/png", Uri = "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png" }, new ExtractionConfig { ForceOcr = true, Ocr = new OcrConfig { Backend = "vlm", Enabled = true, Language = new List<string>() { "eng" }, VlmConfig = new LlmConfig { Model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini", Temperature = 0.0d } } });
Console.WriteLine(result.Results[0].Content);
```
